program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = [6] * 5
    if h == 5:
        blocks = [[row[j:j+5] for row in grid] for j in range(0, w, 6)]

        for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
            if i: out.append(sep)
            out.extend(block)
        return out
    blocks = [grid[i:i+5] for i in range(0, h, 6)]
    if w == 5:
        blocks = blocks[::-1]
        return [[v for k, block in enumerate(blocks) for v in (block[j] + (sep if k < len(blocks)-1 else []))] for j in range(5)]
    tl = [row[:5] for row in grid[:5]]
    tr = [row[6:11] for row in grid[:5]]
    bl = [row[:5] for row in grid[6:11]]
    br = [row[6:11] for row in grid[6:11]]
    out = []
    for i, block in enumerate([tl, br, tr, bl]):
        if i: out.append(sep)
        out.extend(block)
    return out
'''
